title: Beatrice d'Aragona: DECODE R1140, R1141, R1142, R1143, R1154

steps.what: Extracted five exact dates, recipients and shelfmarks from cached DECODE metadata; web reader could not open live DECODE page.
Retrieved Cryptiana index and Berzeviczy 1914 OCR. Located 8 March 1486 letter in no. LVI, not yet compared to cipher.
Used existing user-authorized DECODE cookie to acquire all 18 images. R1143 has repeated photographs with decipherment slips moved.
Located MDE III nos. 10 and 12 for both 1482 letters, III no. 75 for May 1486, IV supplement no. 45 for March cipher and III no. 54 for its closing.

Matched dates, clear wording, cipher boundaries and R1143 manuscript slips to older readings. Rendered print confirms italics and March Virtus/Fortis/M. markers. No exhaustive key verification claimed.
R1154 is plain Italian, explicitly says per non havere cifra; manuscript dates it quingentesimo quinto (1505), agreeing with Berzeviczy no. CCCII.
Visual inspection of MDE III p. 17 corrects OCR holla to printed balla. Preserve machine extracts as uncorrected evidence.

Checked saved source extracts against body-text phrases; corrected initial Berzeviczy extraction that matched the contents entries instead of the letters. Report, profile and local write-up checks passed.

outcome.method_basis: Four cipher letters (R1140-R1143) were already deciphered in print in Nagy-Nyáry, Magyar Diplomácziai Emlékek III (1877) and IV (1878), with manuscript decipherment slips on R1143; the project matched the prints to the DECODE images and applied no key.
outcome.notes: Prior-art resolution: four letters have older printed readings, one is not a cipher. March edition retains unexplained Virtus/Fortis/M. markers. No new decipherment, recovered key or measured glyph coverage.

prior.where: MDE III 1877, IV 1878, Berzeviczy 1914; R1143 also has manuscript decipherment slips. R1154 is plain text.

human: Supplied target catalogue entry and pointed out available DECODE cookie.
